text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaand the winner of the Kikuka Sho
is...
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission... complete!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome run, Bourbon! You made the
Classics
absolutely unforgettable this
year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were fantastic in every single race
of the
Classic Triple Crown! Thank you
for all your hard
work!

Mihono Bourbon looks baffled by these
kind
words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But I...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I was unable to obtain the Triple Crown.

She usually puts the opinions of others
before her
own, but she must be truly
perplexed, as she
remains obstinate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time?
choice_data_list: Then let's see it through next time.

text_block_list.text:
Our goal wasn't just to win the Triple
Crown, but also to make Mihono
Bourbon a runner who
inspires courage
in others.

I'm positive she can get through that

3,200-meter long-distance G1 race in
her current
condition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not have confidence in my ability to
inspire
courage in people...

I push her to remember how the
audience reacted
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Replaying data log...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not know if they were filled with
"courage," but I detected cheering,
encouraging words, and
many positive
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As expected, I am unable to
comprehend. I failed to fulfill the dream
I declared, so why did they
react so
positively?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe I am experiencing the
phenomenon
known as "déjà vu."
choice_data_list: Because there's real power in the ...
Because there's real power in the ...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I... failed...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome run, Bourbon! You were so
cool out
there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thank you for all your hard work!

Mihono Bourbon looks baffled by these
kind
words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But I...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win.

She usually puts the opinions of others
before her
own, but she must be truly
perplexed, as she
remains obstinate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time?
choice_data_list: Then let's see it through next time.

text_block_list.text:
Our goal wasn't just to win the Triple
Crown, but also to make Mihono
Bourbon a runner who
inspires courage
in others.

I'm positive she can get through that

3,200-meter long-distance G1 race in
her current
condition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I do not have confidence in my ability to
inspire
courage in people...

I push her to remember how the
audience reacted
after the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Replaying data log... There were some
negative emotions, but I also detected
cheering,
encouraging words, and many
positive emotions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am unable to comprehend their
reactions. I did
not win, so why did they
react so positively?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe I am experiencing the
phenomenon
known as "déjà vu."
choice_data_list: Because there's real power in the ...
Because there's real power in the ...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I sense your strong "will," Trainer,
just as
I did at
summer camp. However—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The truth is that I cannot determine
whether or
not I can really "inspire
courage" in others.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best, the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, if that is an order, then I will
see it
through. Second order
acknowledged.

And so we set our sights on the spring
Tenno Sho.

Just as we arrive at the academy,
Mihono
Bourbon comes to a sudden
standstill.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: An unknown error has occurred...

Looking confused, she holds a hand to
her chest
and closes her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're coming up on the fourth corner of
the
Kikuka Sho, and Rice Shower is
pulling toward the
front!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Her speed, her intensity, her gaze, her

breathing—is this Rice's "spirit"?)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...Why am I so interested in Rice in the
middle of
a race?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Footage from the Kikuka Sho is
automatically
replaying in my mind. I can
vividly see Rice
running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying this imagery, I detect an

"unsettled" feeling deep in my chest.
What is it?

I'm relieved that she's not in some kind
of
physical pain. Still, I'm not sure what
is causing
her discomfort.

It's possible she's feeling the weight of
Rice
Shower's drive and it's causing her
anxiety.

Suddenly, a group of shrill-voiced high
school
girls walk by.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see?! Mihono Bourbon came
sooooo
close to winning this year's
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I saw! It sucks that she didn't quite
get it,
but she was super amazing!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who do you think would win in a
race
between Mihono Bourbon and
Tokai Teio?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Tokai... Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recurrence of "unsettled" feeling
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't know...
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're worried abou...

text_block_list.text:
She holds her chest with a perplexed
expression.

The two of them have been compared
time and
time again, but she's never
once paid any mind to
Tokai Teio.

And it's not just Tokai Teio—she has the
same
sensation in her chest when she
thinks about Rice
Shower.

Perhaps this is the true nature of the
"unsettled" feeling she's been having
since the Kikuka Sho.
Maybe she's
changing more than I realized.

I just hope it doesn't negatively impact
her
performance in the spring Tenno
Sho...
